item.title: Plume 0.20.0
item.description:
### New
- Let agents start child sessions in new tabs - Accept or dismiss sessions an agent proposes, from a card in the chat - Group a parent tab with its child sessions in the tab bar, and show them in the info pane - Show each agent in a task in the sidebar - Jump directly to a tab from the sidebar - Show Fable quota and usage credits - Clean up the info pane - Show sections more clearly - Make it less overwhelming - Sort pull requests and Linear issues by status - Open a check's page when clicking it - Revamp the conversation minimap - Move to the left side, to avoid conflicting with the info pane - More focus on prompts - Cleaner presentation - Differentiate prompts from questions/plans - Improve scrolling behavior on large conversations - Show a merge conflict indicator on PRs - Improve performance - Improve scrolling performance in long chats - Improve typing performance in the composer - Switch to a task with a long conversation much faster - Show a sent message much faster - Use much less CPU when an agent runs many subagents - Show link chips for more links - Bare GitHub PR and Linear links - Linear Diffs PR links - claude.ai artifact links - Let agents link a Linear issue to their task with `plume issue link` - Show images an agent sends - Compact a conversation from the context meter's popover - Choose to open PR links in GitHub or Linear Diffs, in Settings > Projects - Refresh a conversation's Claude process from its tab to update MCP/skills - Rebind the composer's formatting shortcuts (Bold, Italic, Code, Link) in Settings > Shortcuts - Page the transcript with Page Up and Page Down while typing - Misc fixes - Animate text changes in the sidebar - Place a device tab's toolbar on the side that leaves the device the most room - Track folder, branch, and worktree at the tab level instead of task level - Order Home's Idle section by most recently opened - Link to the running version's release notes from Settings > About - Fix starting a worktree session in a Git LFS repository failing with "git-lfs: command not found" - A worktree that fails to create no longer leaves its new branch behind - A child's finished turn reports to its parent only when the parent started that turn - Show when plan mode runs a different model in the model chip, like when Haiku plans with Sonnet - Double-click the sidebar's edge to restore its default width, and cap how wide it gets - Group mentioned PRs in the info pane - Show Manual in the permission picker when Claude Code reports its "default" mode (which is manual) - Clear out stale window-size settings that piled up with each update - Use more clear icons for Linear's in-progress states - Click a subagent row in the chat to open its transcript - Offer "Always allow" choices on permission requests - Keep a task's branch row when another task in the same folder is deleted - Stop child processes from outliving Plume through inherited pipes
### Recently
- Bundle Plume's agent skills, and offer to install them from Home - Get Beta updates through Settings > Updates > Update source - Update using the built-in updater, even when installed via Homebrew - Add Home page, to keep track of all your chats - Host Android emulators, physical devices, and remote devices in a tab
